name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_GPU_VENDOR_LABEL

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_GPU_RENDERER_LABEL

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_GPU_RENDERER_TOOLTIP

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_WEBGPU_ADAPTER_LABEL
context: Label for the persona WebGPU adapter field
message: WebGPU adapter

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_WEBGPU_ADAPTER_TOOLTIP

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_HARDWARE_CONCURRENCY_LABEL

message: Hardware concurrency

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_HARDWARE_CONCURRENCY_TOOLTIP

message: Overrides navigator.hardwareConcurrency (logical CPU cores). Common desktop values are 4, 8, 10, 12, or 16.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_DEVICE_MEMORY_LABEL
context: Label for the persona device memory field
message: Device memory

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_DEVICE_MEMORY_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona device memory field
message: Overrides navigator.deviceMemory and matching Device-Memory Client Hint headers in gigabytes. Supported buckets are 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_MAX_TOUCH_POINTS_LABEL
context: Label for the persona max touch points field
message: Max touch points

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_MAX_TOUCH_POINTS_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona max touch points field
message: Overrides navigator.maxTouchPoints. Use 0 for most desktop personas and a positive value for touch-capable devices.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_SCREEN_WIDTH_LABEL
context: Label for the persona screen width field
message: Screen width

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_SCREEN_WIDTH_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona screen width field
message: Overrides screen.width in CSS pixels. Keep width, height, avail*, outer*, and DPR consistent with a real display.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_SCREEN_HEIGHT_LABEL
context: Label for the persona screen height field
message: Screen height

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_SCREEN_HEIGHT_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona screen height field
message: Overrides screen.height in CSS pixels. Pair with a realistic width and device pixel ratio for the target device.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_LEFT_LABEL
context: Label for the persona available screen left field
message: Available screen left

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_LEFT_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona available screen left field
message: Overrides screen.availLeft. Usually 0 on single-display desktops; multi-monitor setups may use non-zero values.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_TOP_LABEL
context: Label for the persona available screen top field
message: Available screen top

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_TOP_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona available screen top field
message: Overrides screen.availTop. Often 0, or slightly positive when a menu bar or dock reduces usable area.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_WIDTH_LABEL
context: Label for the persona available screen width field
message: Available screen width

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_WIDTH_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona available screen width field
message: Overrides screen.availWidth. Typically equal to or slightly smaller than screen width.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_HEIGHT_LABEL
context: Label for the persona available screen height field
message: Available screen height

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_AVAIL_HEIGHT_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona available screen height field
message: Overrides screen.availHeight. Usually smaller than screen height because of taskbars or docks.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_OUTER_WIDTH_LABEL
context: Label for the persona outer window width field
message: Outer width

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_OUTER_WIDTH_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona outer window width field
message: Overrides window.outerWidth. For maximized windows this is often close to the available screen width.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_OUTER_HEIGHT_LABEL
context: Label for the persona outer window height field
message: Outer height

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_OUTER_HEIGHT_TOOLTIP
context: Help text for the persona outer window height field
message: Overrides window.outerHeight. Keep it consistent with available screen height for a maximized desktop window.

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_DPR_LABEL
context: Label for the persona device pixel ratio field
message: Device pixel ratio

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PERSONA_FIELD_DPR_TOOLTIP

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PRIVACY_SANDBOX_LEARN_MORE_DIALOG_TOPICS_TITLE
context: TOPICS API A sub title that describes the first of 2 ways a site can get info from Nitrous in order to target ads to the user. Topics of interest include things like “Live comedy” and “Rock music”. Nitrous estimates these interests based on the sites users visit. * “Your”: we need to convey a sense of ownership, even if the user didn’t explicitly choose the interests we’re talking about. Without the “your”, it could sound like Nitrous is simply building a generic library of interests. * “estimated”: It’s an “estimation”, and we don’t want to suggest that we know with certainty the user’s interests. Avoid words like “guess”, “establish”, “define”, etc. (in place of “estimate”). * “by Nitrous”: This is new behavior for a browser (Nitrous) to take an active role in processing user data for the purposes of showing ads. It’s important to convey “chrome”, the actor in this case.
message: Your interests as estimated by Nitrous

name: IDS_SETTINGS_PRIVACY_SANDBOX_AD_MEASUREMENT_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION
context: A description of the Ad measurement API. * “Ad measurement” is the name of an API in this context. We don’t use “API” with the user, but they need to know that there is something called “A measurement” and what it does. * “sites you visit”: call the API to get information. The actor is the site, not Nitrous. * “restricts cross-site tracking”: Today, with 3rd-party cookies, ad measurement technologies can inadvertently (and intentionally) share considerable information from one site to another). This feature restricts that sharing in order to improve the user’s privacy.
message: Ad measurement allows sites you visit to request information from Nitrous that helps the site measure the performance of their ads. Ad measurement restricts cross-site tracking by transferring as little information as possible between sites.
